whats.AI Agents Redefine Business Processes as: As AI takes over more business processes, performance and trust matter. Managers should ask how reliable a tool is before they rely on it.
whats.Gary Vaynerchuk knows where he'd start i: Advice for young founders is a useful prompt for managers too: think about where you would start today, with AI tools now easily available.
whats.Indian Students Worry AI Could Limit In-: Students worry AI may limit deep learning. Managers should think about how new hires build real understanding and not just quick answers.
whats.Uber rival inDrive eyes 2027 robotaxi te: Self-driving taxi tests are being planned with big tech partners. Managers in transport and logistics should watch how this area develops.
whats.NDTV World Summit 2026: Full Day 2 Sched: Business and policy events like this often shape the wider conversation. Managers can use them to keep up with ideas and speakers in the field.

term.def: A robotaxi is a taxi that drives itself using AI, cameras and sensors, with no human driver doing the steering. Companies are testing them in several cities around the world.

prompt.prompt: Act as a careful advisor. Our team wants to use AI for [business process]. List the 5 biggest risks, how we can check the AI's work, and who should approve it.

quiz.q: AI tools like ChatGPT always know when they are wrong and will tell you so.
quiz.why: AI tools can give wrong answers in a confident tone. They do not reliably know when they are mistaken, so important work needs a human check.

quiz.q: The quality of your prompt, meaning the instruction you give, strongly affects the quality of the AI's answer.
quiz.why: Clear instructions with context, a goal and a format usually give better results than a vague, one-line request.

quiz.q: TechCrunch reports that inDrive is eyeing 2027 robotaxi tests in Central Asia with Pony.ai and Nvidia.
quiz.why: This restates the headline. It shows that ride-hailing companies are exploring self-driving taxis with technology partners.

quiz.q: You need to know how to code to get real value from AI tools at work.
quiz.why: Most modern AI tools work with plain language. Managers can write, summarise and analyse using simple everyday instructions.

quiz.q: BW Education reports that Indian students worry AI could limit in-depth learning, according to a survey.
quiz.why: This restates the headline. It reminds managers that people are thinking about how AI affects deep learning and skills.
